findings.text: follow-on: the rewritten test drives only the reckon/mcp.py call site, `mcp._crew(PROJECT, view="everything")` at tests/test_ledger.py:2521. The other production surface, `serve_crew_view` at reckon/mcp_views.py:3749, also returns `crew_view_refusal_detail()`, and no test asserts that site returns the other call site's message (git grep of crew_view_refusal_detail across the tests directory at 82054cc0c finds only this one test, and it reaches the composition only through mcp._crew). A regression that re-forked a private literal back into the serve_crew_view refusal, which is exactly the drift this node was dispatched to end, would leave the suite green.
